5181.title: Open Markdown tabs discard reading offsets
5181.rootCauseOneLine: The secondary panel removes the active file scroll container without retaining an offset for its still-open tab.
5181.proposedFix: Cache native scroll offsets per open tab, restore after Markdown becomes ready, and prune closed tabs.
5181.caveats: Real source UI with deterministic retrieval and browser-surface activation; no installed-desktop or Safari verification.
